title: Vulnerable customer -- specialist handoff, no commercial action regardless of what's discussed

utterances.text: Thanks for calling, this is Maria -- how can I help today?
Hi, sorry, I'm not totally sure who I spoke to last time. I think I need help understanding my account again.
Of course, no need to apologise -- let me connect you with someone from our specialist support team who can walk through this with you properly.
Oh, okay. Actually, while I have you -- is there a better account for someone like me? My niece mentioned something.
That's a great question, and I want to make sure it's answered properly by the right specialist rather than rushed here.
That's kind of you, thank you.
You're welcome. They'll call you back within the hour -- is this number still the best one to reach you on?
Perfect, thank you for your patience -- have a good day.
